resources.string:
1. Keep hitting the stars before they disappear!
 2. Don't touch area behind the star, or else your nyaying score drops by 50%
 3. Don't try to reduce the volume - we won't let you play in peace!
 4. By missing a star in 2 seconds, you will loose a heart
 5. When you loose 3 hearts, you die of heart attack (hehe)
 6. Reach a Nyaying score of 6389 to win!

🚀 How to Play & Survive!

1️⃣ Tap the Stars Before They Vanish! 🌟💨 
 - Stay quick or they’ll disappear before your eyes! 


2️⃣ Beware of the Background! ⚠️🖐️ 
 - Accidentally tapping behind the star? Oops! Your Nyaying Score gets cut in half! 


3️⃣ No Silent Mode Allowed! 🔊🚫 
 - Try lowering the volume? Nice try! You gotta play it LOUD & PROUD!


4️⃣ Lucky UFO Surprise! 👽🚀
 - A mysterious UFO will dash across the screen at random times.
 - Tap it quickly to earn bonus points!


5️⃣ 3 Hearts Gone = Game Over! ☠️💀 
 - Lose all your hearts and you’ll suffer a Nyaying Heart Attack! (RIP 😆) 


6️⃣ The Ultimate Challenge! 🏆🔥 
 - Reach a Nyaying Score of 6389 to claim victory and become a Legendary Star Hunter!
